subject.summary: Pile driver operators run pile driving rigs according to the construction plan and site signals, driving piles into the foundation to support buildings, bridges, or wharves. The core is pre-shift inspection, pile position and hammer position control, observing abnormalities, and stopping work on instruction; paper exercises must not be treated as authorization to operate real equipment.
